note: Golden Sample regression set (build 230). Clips ship as .mp4.b64 (the deploy channel is text-only, same as the fonts) and are materialized to .mp4 by pipeline/golden_check.py on first use. To replace a clip with a real-world one, drop the new file at clips/<file>.mp4 (or re-encode it to .b64), then re-capture baselines from Admin or `python -m pipeline.golden_check --capture`.
